Our Story

Throwing back to 1978, Kai Shing Management Services Limited (Kai Shing) was established by SHKP to
provide professional and quality property management services for its properties. With our collective efforts and concerted actions,
the company has delivered excellent performance and solid made significant progress gradually.
Today, Kai Shing has established a strong presence and garnered numerous awards in Hong Kong
and major cities across China through its property management services,
which has already earned a prominent position in the industry!

For nearly half a century, we has been accompanied our customers throughout all the different stage of life
by upholding the core value of “Building Homes with Heart”,
gradually shaping the uniqueness of Kai Shing’s brand value.

The services we offer are meticulous, attentive and all-rounded to ensure the needs of residents are fully met.
We pay attention to details, we think about innovation, and we are Kai Shing!

Logo Story

The shape and colour of the new brand logo embodies the forward-thinking spirit of Kai Shing,
showcasing our service intention with a fresh visual display.
It also upholds the core value of “Building Homes with Heart” and brings a new level of innovation to property management services,
aiming to create a better living environment for our customers!

In terms of colour, a bright and steady copper yellow is chosen, it presents in different shades of the same colour tone.
This showcases the brand’s professional and reliable personality, while also representing its flexibility and elegant image.
The iconic “K” symbolizes Kai Shing with its upward lines forming an arrow,
highlighting Kai Shing’s leading position in the industry and its commitment to provide excellent service.
With the new reliable and dynamic brand image,
Kai Shing will continue to keep our service promise by offering exceptional services and delivering additional values for our customers.

Our Philosophy
Serve with Heart

With the adherence of the customer-centric culture, we consistently focus on the needs of customers and listen patiently, to create an ideal living environment for them with the highest quality service.

Our Philosophy
Innovation with Heart

In an era of rapid technological advancements, customer expectations for environmental protection and quality living are constantly rising. Therefore, Kai Shing constantly innovates and introduces new technologies in property management, to meet the expectations of the new generations, allowing customers to enjoy a more thoughtful living experience.

Our Philosophy
Connecting Hearts

Kai Shing believes that the quality of life comes from the connections between people. We are committed to providing high-quality property management services and sincerely caring about each customer. We attentively provide our customers with the facilities and services they need, allowing Kai Shing and customers, or customers with each other, to come closer and achieve harmony and integration.

Our Philosophy
Creating a Sustainable Future

“Home” not only represents a dwelling place, but also the place where we live together. Joining hands with our staff and customers, we are committed to creating a sustainable future to ensure a high quality of life for all.
